#include <iostream>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <utility>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

long long count_ways(int n, int h, unordered_map<pair<int, int>, long long, hash_pair> &memo) {
    pair<int, int> key = make_pair(n, h);
    if (memo.find(key) == memo.end()) {
        if (n == 0) {
            memo[key] = 1;
        } else {
            long long sum = 0;
            if (h != 0) {
                for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                    sum += count_ways(i, h - 1, memo) * count_ways(n - 1 - i, h - 1, memo);
                }
                memo[key] = sum;
            } else {
                memo[key] = 0;
            }
        }
    }
    return memo[key];
}

struct hash_pair {
    size_t operator()(const pair<int, int>& p) const {
        return hash<int>()(p.first) ^ (hash<int>()(p.second) << 1);
    }
};

int main() {
    int n, h;
    cin >> n >> h;
    unordered_map<pair<int, int>, long long, hash_pair> memo;
    long long result = count_ways(n, n, memo) - count_ways(n, max(0, h - 1), memo);
    cout << result << endl;
    return 0;
}
